text.slice: Porting ColorOS / OxygenOS / RealmeUI
The port is based on two firmware packages: the "base" (ColorOS/OxygenOS/RealmeUI — the source of the shell itself) and the "stock" firmware of the phone to which the port is being transferred.
Any base with the same SoC as the target device is suitable for porting — MTK only to MTK, Qualcomm only to Qualcomm.
Step 1. Unpacking the Base
Unpack the payload.bin of the ColorOS/OxygenOS/RealmeUI base and extract the following partitions:
system, system_ext, product, all my_** (my_manifest, my_product, etc.), vendor, odm
Step 2. Unpacking the Stock Firmware
Download the stock firmware of the phone to which you are porting and extract from it:
vendor, odm, system_ext, **_dlkm (if present)
Step 3. Transferring VNDK APEX
Copy all vndk apex files from stock/system_ext/apex/ to ColorOS/system_ext/apex/.
If such an apex is not yet present in ColorOS (e.g., vndk34 is missing) — copy it.
If such an apex already exists — leave it untouched by default.
Exception: if a bootloop occurs after building and flashing — try replacing the already existing apex with the version from stock, even if it was already there.
Step 4. Copying group and passwd
Copy two files — group and passwd — from ColorOS/vendor/etc/ to stock/vendor/etc/ (with replacement).
Step 5. Merging my-partitions
Run the script that merges my_** partitions with system:
Step 6. Editing build.prop
In system/my_manifest/build.prop, completely delete the line:
ro.product.first_api_level
Step 7. First Boot
At this stage, you can try to build the firmware and boot.
If it does not boot:
1. Copy ColorOS/odm/build.prop to stock/odm/build.prop
2. Add the following line to the end of stock/odm/etc/build.prop:
import /odm/build.prop
After this, the firmware should boot.
If it still does not boot — try changing the base (remember about SoC matching, see Step 1).
How to Build Properly
It is recommended to build in erofs, raw format.
Build from ColorOS/OxygenOS/RealmeUI (base):
system, product, system_ext
Build from stock firmware:
vendor, odm, all **_dlkm (including system_dlkm)
A vendor partition from any Android version is suitable for the port — to any Android version of the base.
